description: This Java class defines custom assertion methods for collections of Bson objects, used for testing MongoDB-related code. It extends AssertJ's AbstractIterableAssert to provide specific equality assertions for Bson collections, including order-sensitive and order-insensitive comparisons.

classes.name: BsonCollectionAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for collections of Bson objects, providing methods to check equality with order and without order.

methods.name: BsonCollectionAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion with a collection of Bson objects.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Asserts that the actual collection of Bson objects is equal to the expected collection, considering order.

methods.name: isEqualToInAnyOrder
methods.description: Asserts that the actual collection of Bson objects is equal to the expected collection, ignoring order.

methods.name: toAssert
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to its corresponding BsonAssert for further assertions.

methods.name: newAbstractIterableAssert
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BsonCollectionAssert from an iterable.
